question: Pila ka adlaw valid ang excavation permit ug pila ang bayad sa inspection ug kada cubic meter sa pagkalot sa pundasyon?
answer:
The Excavation Permit is valid for thirty (30) days, as stated in [S1] and [S3].

The Inspection and Verification Fee for the issuance of the Ground Preparation and Excavation Permit (GP&EP) is Php 200.00, as stated in [S1]. The fee per cubic meter of excavation is Php 3.00 for regular excavation and Php 4.00 for excavation other than foundation or basement, as stated in [S1]. For foundation with basement, the fee per cubic meter of excavation is Php 4.00, as stated in [S1].

For renewal of the GP&EP, the fee per cubic meter of excavation is Php 4.00, as stated in [S2]. The fee per square meter of structure is Php 38.00, as stated in [S2].

For a structure with a height of more than 10 meters, the first 10-meter height has a fee of Php 2,400.00, as stated in [S2]. For every meter or fraction thereof in excess of 10 meters, the fee is Php 120.00, as stated in [S2].

The Ground Preparation and Excavation Fee is not specified in the provided sources for the certificate of annual inspection for mechanical new schedule of fees and other charges of the revised implementing rules and regulations (IRR) of the National Building Code of the Philippines (PD 1096), as stated in [S5].

ground_truth: While the Building Permit is being processed, the Building Official may issue GP&EP for foundation subject to line-and-grade verification, inspection and review. It is valid only for 30 days or superseded upon Building Permit issuance. Fees: inspection/verification PHP200; excavation PHP3 per cubic meter; GP&EP issuance PHP50; foundation excavation with basement PHP4 per cubic meter; excavation other than foundation/basement PHP3 per cubic meter; permitted footing/foundation encroachment into public areas PHP250 per square meter or fraction thereof.
